- **Age:** forty-five  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v3 ch.Again P58](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0058), [v3 ch.People P3](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0003)</sub>

- **Family:** [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) (spouse), [Stanhope](../character/stanhope.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

A tiny woman, Rosalind has a bright, youthful complexion with rosy cheeks, sweet lips, and dimples, alongside a status as someone who never ages. She features lovely, thick, wavy hair as white as snow that is thoughtfully set in flattering puffs and coils. Her large, gentle wood-brown eyes sparkle with welcome and contain tiny flecks of gold.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v3 ch.Again P58](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0058)_

## History

Rosalind Penrose was considered a beauty in her youth and was named by her father after his love for the fragrance of lavender. Twenty-five years ago, she was engaged to [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md), but they separated following a quarrel driven by a prideful misunderstanding. She subsequently withdrew from social life to live in isolation at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), causing her existence to be largely forgotten. Years later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde stumbled upon [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), where Rosalind entertained them and learned that Stephen's son, [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), was in the area. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) later brought [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) to meet Rosalind, and the two formed a swift bond. When [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) unexpectedly arrived in the area and sent word requesting a visit, Rosalind received him at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), where they reconciled and embraced in the garden. Soon after, friends helped prepare [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) for their wedding, and the couple married in the garden before departing by train. During a subsequent visit to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), Miss Rosalind gently questioned [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about why she refused to marry Hugh.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), +26 more_

## Quotes

> “Cedric Stanhope?” Miss Rosalind’s tone shifted slightly. “What is his identity? I was under the impression that no person with that name resided in Brierley.”
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081)

> "When you arrived here on that initial day, Nell, learning of Stephen’s boy startled me. Though I have been unable to bring him up to you from that moment on, I have longed to hear everything concerning him. How would you describe the boy?"
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "It makes me thoroughly embarrassed that an untested gown . . . even one made of forget-me-not organdy . . . can thrill me in this way, whereas a clean conscience plus an increased donation to Foreign Missions failed to accomplish it."
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P19](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0019)

> "For what I spent on them, those drapes ought to have lasted longer. Goodness, Belinda neglected to wipe down the banister once more. I am certainly going to have to address that with her."
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P58](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0058)

> "I observe that a problem has arisen, Nell. I will be intrusive and inquire about its nature. Have the two of you had a disagreement?"
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v3 ch.People P25](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0025)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--rosalind-penrose.md)

Rosalind and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are close friends who visit each other regularly. Their friendship began when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally discovered [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) and stayed for tea, later returning for a cozy winter night where Rosalind confided the story of her past romance. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) subsequently helped facilitate Rosalind's reunion with her past lover, and she continues to visit [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) and confide in Rosalind about her personal life.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), +17 more_

- Friend of — close friends who visit each other  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P31](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0031), [v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), +2 more</sub>

### [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rosalind-penrose--stephen-stanhope.md)

Rosalind and [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) were engaged long ago, but a prideful misunderstanding separated them for years. After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reconnected them by delivering a message, [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) visited [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), where the two embraced as lovers. They subsequently married in a garden ceremony at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) before leaving together by train.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P20](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0020), +12 more_

### [Stanhope](../character/stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rosalind-penrose--stanhope.md)

[Stanhope](../character/stanhope.md) is Rosalind's husband following their romantic reunion. After resolving their past separation, the two were married at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) and departed together as newlyweds. Rosalind later settled into married life while continuing to host visitors at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage).

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P16](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0016), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), +18 more_
